results.title: 10 simultaneous code requests for one address

results.title: The correct code submitted 5 times at once

results.title: Two guards receive the same item at the same moment
results.expected: One succeeds; one RECEIVED entry in the history
results.observed: successful receives per trial: Counter({1: 10}); RECEIVED entries per item: Counter({1: 10})

results.title: One student sends the same claim 5 times at once
results.expected: 1 claim created; the rest refused with 409, no server errors
results.observed: claims created per item: Counter({1: 10}); responses: {409: 40, 201: 10}
results.note: The database index guarantees one open claim; the question is how the duplicates are answered.

results.title: Two guards approve two different claims on one item at once
One guard approves while another rejects the same claim
results.note: Two decisions mean the history shows both, the claimant may get both emails, and the final status is whichever wrote last.

results.title: Two guards hand over the same item at once
results.expected: One hand-over: 1 COLLECTED and 1 RETURNED entry
results.observed: COLLECTED entries: Counter({1: 10}); RETURNED entries: Counter({1: 10})

results.title: Claimant withdraws at the moment a guard hands the item over
results.expected: Either returned (claim collected) or still held (claim withdrawn), never a mix
results.observed: outcomes: {'claim WITHDRAWN / item IN_CUSTODY': 6, 'claim COLLECTED / item RETURNED': 4}; inconsistent: 0
